authors: Pedro (Pedro Yochinori Gushiken) - single-author reports credit only him; no other names found

title: APPC, m Files version (true plant used in the Diophantine equation)
authors: Pedro (header 'Aluno: Pedro Gushiken')
description: Same APPC as the AC_Metodos archive, but with the polynomial filter (tf2ss), Lambda-sized controller filters, and theta estimates clamped to >=0.1. title: Inverse-time overcurrent relay curves (IEC MI / NI / EI)
authors: Pedro (probable)
description: It computes trip time t = k*TMS/(M^alpha - 0.9) for the IEC very inverse (13.5, alpha=1, labelled 'MI'), normal inverse (0.14, 0.02, 'NI') and extremely inverse (80, 2, 'EI') curves. TMS runs 0.1-1.0 and the current multiple M runs 1.1-20. It plots log(t) in three subplots. The denominator uses -0.9 instead of the standard -1, either a deliberate offset or a slip.
context: Undergraduate 'Protecao de Sistemas Eletricos e de Potencia' (2015.2). A 'Protecao ... Listas' folder exists under Documentos/Arquivo Eletrica/Tarefas Final Semestre. Found in 'Projetos a Organizar' ('projects to sort out'). A copy is in MATLAB_Files_Old.rar/Projetos a Organizar
